# Tracelet

> Tracelet is a backend-agnostic, privacy-first browser analytics SDK written in TypeScript.

Use Tracelet when an application needs typed events, consent-aware collection, a persistent browser queue, retry semantics, and replaceable codecs, compression, storage, and transports.

## Important boundaries

- Package name: `tracelet-browser`
- License: MIT
- The SDK is backend-agnostic and does not include a hosted analytics backend.
- Autocapture observes SPA navigation and global errors; it does not scan DOM text, form values, or `data-*` attributes.
- Delivery is at least once. Collectors must deduplicate by `eventId`.
